description: Explains a basic astrology topic in plain words from Zodiacs' own pages, with links to them. Use it for what-does-X-mean questions, and for whether two Sun signs are compatible, such as Leo and Scorpio, which it answers from that sign-pair page. For two Sun signs as friends, include the word friendship: that answer is the element and modality pattern alone, with no romance, and it is the reading to give anyone under 18. For the person's own placements, use get_natal_chart. It covers a sign and its traits, a planet, a planet in a sign or a house, the houses or one house, aspects or one aspect, retrogrades and Mercury retrograde, Moon phases, the void-of-course Moon, eclipses, the rising sign or one sign rising, the Midheaven, the big three, cusps, the Saturn return, the solar return, elements, modalities, transits, synastry, Sun-sign pairs or the Chinese zodiac. Give the topic in a few words. If nothing matches, or the topic is tarot, numerology, horary, Vedic astrology or another system Zodiacs does not cover, it returns found: false with the topics it does explain; do not present an explainer of your own as Zodiacs'. If either person is under 18, give the friendship reading and do not frame the pair as romance or attraction.

topic.description: What to explain, in a few words: a sign (leo), a planet (Mercury), a placement (Moon in Scorpio, Jupiter in the 12th), the houses or one house (seventh house), aspects or one aspect (square), retrogrades or Mercury retrograde, Moon phases, the rising sign or a sign rising (Leo rising), the Midheaven, the big three, cusps, Saturn return, elements, modalities, transits, synastry, eclipses or the Chinese zodiac.

note.const: An introduction to how astrology reads these ideas, not a claim that they determine anything.
